# The Mercury News

> > The Mercury News is the Bay Area's leading daily newspaper delivering comprehensive local, national, and international news coverage through digital and e-Edition formats.

The Mercury News serves the San Francisco Bay Area with breaking news, investigative journalism, and in-depth coverage of local communities, politics, technology, sports, and entertainment. As one of the region's most trusted news sources, it provides subscribers with daily digital editions and real-time news updates.

## Key Topics

- Bay Area news
- Digital e-Edition
- Daily headlines
- Local journalism
- Breaking news
- Subscription content
- San Francisco Bay Area
- Community coverage
- News delivery platforms
- Regional reporting

## Digital Edition

- [e-Edition - Digital Newspaper](https://eedition.mercurynews.com/): Digital replica of The Mercury News with Bay Area daily headlines, available for subscribers in an interactive online format
